clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, Duthorian Rall guides new holy warriors through their trials. The respected human knight of the Silver Hand is one of the Alliance's most influential paladins, overseeing their training and spiritual tests. He teaches charity, valor, and devotion as they prepare to defend Azeroth from the Scourge and threats within the kingdom.

In the Cathedral of Light, Duthorian Rall upholds the traditions of the Knights of the Silver Hand. The kingdom is unsettled by internal strife, and King Varian Wrynn is missing. Duthorian carries the duty of teaching discipline to new initiates. Respected paladins in the field send promising recruits to him: Brother Wilhelm in Goldshire and Brandur Ironhammer in Ironforge, so they can begin their sacred trials.

Duthorian teaches that martial power without a moral foundation is hollow. In the Tome of Divinity trials, he tests an initiate's empathy through acts of mercy and selfless service across Stormwind. Only after these tests does he entrust candidates with deeper mysteries. Near Heroes' Vigil, he tests them with the Symbol of Life, then sends them to aid wounded allies and learn to channel the Light's power to restore fallen comrades from death.
